newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Credit Industries Q4 shr up.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Credit Industries Q4 shr up.

text.p: Dollars in thousands except per share amounts
Fully diluted net income per share 0.37 0.17 1.95 0.40
NOTE: Full company name is Imperial Credit Industries Inc.

Gain on sale of loans increased $9.0 million or 94% to $18.6 million during the fourth quarter of 1996 from $9.6 million for the same period last year. The increase in gain on sale of loans was primarily attributable to the securitization and sale of loans during the fourth quarter of 1996 at Southern Pacific Funding Corporation, Franchise Mortgage Acceptance Company LLC, and Imperial Business Credit Inc. of $235.0 million, $157.7 million and $19.3 million, respectively. During the fourth quarter of 1995, loan securitization and sales totaled $319.0 million. For the year ended December 31, 1996, gain on sale of loans increased $48.6 million or 123% to $88.2 million as compared to $39.6 million for the year ended December 31, 1995. Loan securizations and sales for the years ended December 31, 1996 and 1995 were, $1.3 billion and $1.0 billion, respectively.
